head.title: Event Lighting, Gensets, Truss & Furniture — Hamsalekha | Hamsalekha Event Production

meta.name: description
meta.content: Lighting, 40–125 KVA gensets, Bombay truss, premium furniture and full event production for weddings and corporate events in Bengaluru.

meta.name: keywords
meta.content: event production company Bengaluru,event lighting Bangalore,genset rental for events Bangalore,truss and staging Bengaluru,wedding furniture rental Bangalore,luxury event furniture,glass house wedding set
Event lighting, gensets, truss, premium furniture and props in Bengaluru. Twenty years of weddings, celebrations and corporate events.
